lines.text: On the plains of Moab across from Jericho, the LORD tells Moses to drive out Canaan's inhabitants and destroy their idols.
The LORD says to divide the land by lot, and any inhabitants who remain will become thorns in Israel's sides.
The LORD gives Moses the borders of Canaan, with the western border being the coastline of the Red Sea.
Moses commands Israel to divide the land by lot among nine and a half tribes, since Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh already have land.
The LORD names Eleazar the priest and Phinehas son of Nun, plus one leader from each tribe, to distribute the land.
